properties.name: component-config.item32
properties.description: EU regulation item configuration (ITEM 32c). Mutually exclusive with item35.

properties.name: component-config.item32.regulation
properties.description: Regulation type. Must be EU for item32.

properties.name: component-config.item32.tr-code
properties.description: TR code used in the CSV file header (e.g. TRRGS).

properties.name: component-config.item32.regulation-reference
properties.description: Regulation reference used in the CSV file header (e.g. EMIR).

properties.name: component-config.item32.submission-volumes-file-name-pattern
properties.description: File name pattern for Submission Volumes report. Use YYYYMMDD as date placeholder.

properties.name: component-config.item32.report-generation-file-name-pattern
properties.description: File name pattern for Report Generation report (ITEM32c for EU). Use YYYYMMDD as date placeholder.

properties.name: component-config.item32.storage-capacity-file-name-pattern
properties.description: File name pattern for Storage Capacity report. Use YYYYMMDD as date placeholder.

properties.name: component-config.item32.compute-capacity-file-name-pattern
properties.description: File name pattern for Compute Capacity report. Use YYYYMMDD as date placeholder.

properties.name: component-config.item32.translation
properties.description: Translation mappings for accounts and reports.
